items.question: What WNBA teams did Noelle Quinn play for?
items.answer: Noelle Quinn played 12 WNBA seasons for five teams: the Minnesota Lynx, Los Angeles Sparks, Washington Mystics, Seattle Storm and Phoenix Mercury. Minnesota drafted her fourth overall out of UCLA in 2007, and she won the 2018 title as a player with Seattle.

items.question: What is Noelle Quinn doing now?
items.answer: Noelle Quinn is an assistant coach at UCLA, her alma mater, which added her to its staff ahead of the 2026-27 season. She was named the first head coach of Unrivaled's Breeze BC in October 2025 and also serves as an assistant coach for Canada's senior women's national team.

items.question: Is Noelle Quinn still the Seattle Storm coach?
items.answer: No. The Storm announced that Noelle Quinn's contract would not be renewed for the 2026 season. She was Seattle's head coach from 2021 through 2025, going 97-89 and winning the 2021 Commissioner's Cup, after serving as an assistant on the 2020 title team.
